title: Krafla 地熱與回注系統
summary: 以火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注解析Krafla 地熱與回注系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Krafla geothermal and reinjection system through volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 蓋在活火山上的電廠：岩漿上方的熱通量、火山氣體、套管熱應力與延後二十年的機組
v30FocusEn: A plant on an active volcano: heat flux above magma, volcanic gas, casing thermal stress and a unit twenty years late

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Krafla 地熱與回注系統案例中比較Krafla儲層觀測與高溫井與完整性，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate krafla reservoir observations and high-temperature well integrity within the Krafla geothermal and reinjection system case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Krafla儲層觀測提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for krafla reservoir observations.
steps.instruction: 在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Krafla儲層觀測。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify krafla reservoir observations in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Krafla儲層觀測的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for krafla reservoir observations.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界

knowledge.textEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體12 kg/s、比焓降310 kJ/kg，熱量率=3720 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=346.4 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 12 kg/s and enthalpy drop 310 kJ/kg: heat rate 3720 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=346.4 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的「儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis” in “Krafla geothermal and reinjection system”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就Krafla儲層觀測的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in krafla reservoir observations?
options: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。
測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Krafla儲層觀測提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for krafla reservoir observations.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Krafla儲層觀測的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving krafla reservoir observations. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Krafla儲層觀測的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 井筒完整性與熱損：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對高溫井與完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for high-temperature well integrity.
steps.instruction: 在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識高溫井與完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify high-temperature well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交高溫井與完整性的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for high-temperature well integrity.
